deadlinePolicy.appliesTo: Twelve formative quizzes/project updates and five milestone snapshots
deadlinePolicy.releaseRule: Only the individual case exam has an offering-specific available-from date. Other items retain no release or lock date.
deadlinePolicy.lateWork: Retain the existing offering late-work policy; this schedule does not add or alter a penalty.
deadlinePolicy.holidayNote: Sunday deadlines preceding Monday closures remain; no live meeting or holiday response is required.
deadlinePolicy.recordAuthority: Native Canvas due dates and instructor feedback are the official offering record.

individualExam.initialSubmissionPolicy: May 2 is an optional early-feedback checkpoint, not an extra graded or Canvas due date.
individualExam.revisionPolicy: Revisions through the actual May 5 due date use the same assignment and are not late because they follow the optional checkpoint. Existing late-work rules otherwise remain.

feedbackPolicy.finalAssessmentException: Final exam feedback target is May 10, not five working days after May 5. Optional submissions by May 2 have a May 4 feedback target.
feedbackPolicy.note: These are facilitated-offering targets; do not promise instant or holiday service.
